name: free-to-review
description: Code reviews and requests answered by free LLMs via OpenRouter, from two slash commands.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key from openrouter.ai/keys. Stored in secure storage.

panel.title: Panel size
panel.description: How many different free models to ask at once (1-3). Each model uses one request of your daily free quota.

models.title: Preferred models
models.description: Optional comma-separated OpenRouter model IDs. Leave empty to pick free models automatically.
